summary: Lisata Therapeutics filed an 8-K disclosing an amendment to its merger agreement with Kuva Labs and its acquisition subsidiary. The amendment extends the outside date from July 1, 2026, to July 17, 2026, and offers a potential further extension to August 17, 2026, contingent on a $1.5M non-refundable fee from Parent. It also delays the tender offer start to June 10, 2026, and includes waivers of claims by Lisata for past failures to commence the offer and missed interim operating payments. The agreement allows Lisata to terminate the waivers if Parent defaults on payments or materially breaches. Watch for regulatory clearance progress and risk-arb spread on extension fee exercise and potential deal renegotiation or termination.
